services.desc: Welcome to Moby Nick's Charter Fishing aboard the Rod Wrestler, providing you with the best sport fishing Lake Ontario has to offer. This boat is infamous on Lake Ontario. She's a 42' floating predator for the big ones, and she's got a way of sniffing them out like no other boat out there. After you've landed that water-breathing monster, kick back and take a load off. She's equipped with all the luxuries of home.
